summary: Tested iteration 11 bug fix for user permissions, removal of Reports page, and removal of PDF buttons from Inc & Exp page. All 11 feature test cases passed. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend: Admin sees full nav, restricted user (permtest with page_permissions=['dashboard','rooms','bookings']) sees ONLY those 3 items, and gets 'Access Denied' when navigating directly to /settings or /income-expense. Reports page removed from nav and routes. Daily/Monthly Sales tabs have only 'Download Excel' (no PDF).

features_verified.login_returns_page_permissions: PASS - POST /api/auth/login returns user.page_permissions (admin=[], staff=limited list)
features_verified.available_pages_excludes_reports: PASS - GET /api/users/available-pages returns 13 pages, 'reports' not in list
features_verified.create_restricted_user: PASS - POST /api/users with page_permissions=['dashboard','rooms','bookings'] creates user and persists permissions
features_verified.admin_nav_full: PASS - Admin sees Dashboard, Calendar, Restaurant, Rooms, Guests, Bookings, Financial, Expenses, Payroll, Settings (no Reports)
features_verified.restricted_nav_filtered: PASS - Permtest sees ONLY Dashboard, Rooms, Bookings. Hidden: Financial, Expenses, Restaurant, Calendar, Payroll, Settings, Guests, Reports
features_verified.page_guard_settings: PASS - /settings as permtest shows 'Access Denied - You don't have permission to view this page.'
features_verified.allowed_page_rooms: PASS - /rooms accessible as permtest, no Access Denied
features_verified.reports_route_removed: PASS - /reports URL falls back to default (no Reports component rendered)
features_verified.no_pdf_daily_sales: PASS - Daily Sales tab shows only 'Download Excel' button, no PDF button
features_verified.no_pdf_monthly_sales: PASS - Monthly Sales tab shows only 'Download Excel' button, no PDF button

critical_code_review_comments: Unused PDF functions downloadDailyPDF (line 5274) and downloadMonthlyPDF (line 5304) remain in App.js even though their buttons were removed. jsPDF import at line 6 is also unused. Consider removing to reduce bundle size.
App.js is extremely large (~15000+ lines). Should be split into multiple component files for maintainability.
Permissions filter works via Navigation.hasPageAccess() plus PageGuard component wrapping each route - good defense in depth.

restricted_test.note: Create via POST /api/users with page_permissions=['dashboard','rooms','bookings']; cleaned up after testing

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 'permtest' user (Staff role, page_permissions=['dashboard','rooms','bookings']) for permission testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Permissions system works end-to-end. To test restricted user flows, create via POST /api/users as admin with page_permissions list, then login - the login response includes user.page_permissions which the frontend uses in both Navigation.hasPageAccess (to filter nav links) and PageGuard component (to show 'Access Denied' for direct URL access). Admin role bypasses all permission checks. Reports page is fully removed - no route, no nav link, not in /api/users/available-pages.
